populations.csv.name: season_id
populations.csv.description: New season identifier; not original dataset seasons 1–5.

populations.csv.name: population_id
populations.csv.description: Unique harvest population; stable across all linked files.

populations.csv.name: analysis_cluster_id
populations.csv.description: Independent population cluster used for resampling; shared where populations are dependent.

populations.csv.name: orchard_or_supplier_id
populations.csv.description: Pseudonymous source identifier; retain linkage under custody.

populations.csv.name: cultivar
populations.csv.description: Recorded cultivar, not inferred from spectra.

populations.csv.name: independence_attestation_id
populations.csv.description: Evidence that original seasons 1–5 and shared fruit/derived observations are excluded.

fruits.csv.name: fruit_id
fruits.csv.description: Unique physical fruit identifier, never a scan identifier.

fruits.csv.name: harvested_at_utc
fruits.csv.description: Actual harvest time; empty when not known, with a documented reason.

fruits.csv.name: eligibility_status
fruits.csv.description: eligible, ineligible, or pending; determined without model errors.

fruits.csv.name: eligibility_reason
fruits.csv.description: Required reason for noneligible or pending status.

fruits.csv.name: disposition
fruits.csv.description: enrolled, withdrawn, lost, or analyzed; preserve all recruited fruit.

scans.csv.name: measurement_mode
scans.csv.description: spectral_replay or physical_device; do not pool modes.

scans.csv.name: raw_file_path
scans.csv.description: Relative path under the source archive; no external traversal.

scans.csv.name: raw_file_sha256
scans.csv.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of unmodified source bytes.

scans.csv.name: spectral_schema_id
scans.csv.description: Frozen wavelength grid, units and signal-representation schema.

scans.csv.name: qc_status
scans.csv.description: pass, fail, or pending based on registered outcome-independent rules.

scans.csv.name: qc_reason_code
scans.csv.description: Required for fail or pending; rule IDs must be registered.

spectral_values.csv.name: wavelength_nm
spectral_values.csv.description: Wavelength in nm; exact frozen grid required for replay.

spectral_values.csv.name: signal_value
spectral_values.csv.description: Finite untransformed supplied input value in declared representation.

spectral_values.csv.name: signal_representation
spectral_values.csv.description: Frozen input representation; do not silently change log or absorbance convention.

assay_aliquots_restricted.csv.name: lab_sample_id
assay_aliquots_restricted.csv.description: Blinded laboratory sample identifier; no model predictions supplied.

assay_aliquots_restricted.csv.name: fresh_mass_g
assay_aliquots_restricted.csv.description: Positive recorded fresh sample mass in grams.

assay_aliquots_restricted.csv.name: dry_mass_g
assay_aliquots_restricted.csv.description: Recorded dry sample mass in grams under assay SOP.

assay_aliquots_restricted.csv.name: drying_endpoint_record
assay_aliquots_restricted.csv.description: Evidence required by assay SOP; do not invent a fixed drying duration.

assay_aliquots_restricted.csv.name: assay_qc_status
assay_aliquots_restricted.csv.description: pass, fail, or pending under frozen laboratory rules.

assay_references_restricted.csv.name: lab_sample_id
assay_references_restricted.csv.description: One reconciled reference per blinded laboratory sample.

assay_references_restricted.csv.name: reference_dm_percent
assay_references_restricted.csv.description: Fresh-weight dry matter percent, from 100 * dry_mass / fresh_mass and registered reconciliation.

assay_references_restricted.csv.name: reconciliation_rule_id
assay_references_restricted.csv.description: Frozen rule resolving technical replicates; do not choose best agreement with predictions.

assay_references_restricted.csv.name: assay_archive_sha256
assay_references_restricted.csv.description: Hash of retained laboratory aliquot archive.

assay_references_restricted.csv.name: assay_frozen_at_utc
assay_references_restricted.csv.description: Reference freeze time before model-linkage release.

assay_linkage_restricted.csv.name: released_at_utc
assay_linkage_restricted.csv.description: Release time after predictions have been frozen.

assay_linkage_restricted.csv.name: prediction_freeze_id
assay_linkage_restricted.csv.description: Foreign key to an immutable prediction freeze.

assay_linkage_restricted.csv.name: prediction_manifest_sha256
assay_linkage_restricted.csv.description: Hash of complete frozen prediction manifest before linkage.

scan_predictions.csv.name: model_bundle_sha256
scan_predictions.csv.description: Hash identifying frozen bundle used at inference.

scan_predictions.csv.name: predicted_dm_percent
scan_predictions.csv.description: Finite dry-matter prediction; empty only for a logged prediction failure.

scan_predictions.csv.name: failure_reason
scan_predictions.csv.description: Required for failure; never substitute zero for a failure.

fruit_predictions.csv.name: fruit_id
fruit_predictions.csv.description: One row per fruit/model for aggregation.

fruit_predictions.csv.name: model_bundle_sha256
fruit_predictions.csv.description: Hash identifying the frozen inference bundle.

fruit_predictions.csv.name: mean_predicted_dm_percent
fruit_predictions.csv.description: Arithmetic mean of common eligible scan predictions; empty when fruit unavailable.

fruit_predictions.csv.name: eligible_paired_scan_count
fruit_predictions.csv.description: Same retained scan set across all three models for a fruit.

fruit_predictions.csv.name: scan_prediction_sd_pp
fruit_predictions.csv.description: Descriptive repeat variation; empty with fewer than two scans.

fruit_predictions.csv.name: availability_status
fruit_predictions.csv.description: available or unavailable under registered minimum scan count.

fruit_predictions.csv.name: prediction_freeze_id
fruit_predictions.csv.description: Immutable freeze identifier before assay linkage.

qc_dispositions.csv.name: validation_outcomes_accessed
qc_dispositions.csv.description: true or false; true requires protocol-deviation disclosure.

freeze_manifest.csv.name: stage
freeze_manifest.csv.description: registration, model, inputs, qc, scan_predictions, fruit_predictions, assays, linkage, or analysis.

freeze_manifest.csv.name: prior_freeze_id
freeze_manifest.csv.description: Earlier immutable freeze if this is an amendment; empty otherwise.

freeze_manifest.csv.name: amendment_reason
freeze_manifest.csv.description: Required if superseding a prior freeze; preserve prior artifact.

independence_checks.csv.name: lineage_evidence
independence_checks.csv.description: Origin, date and custody evidence beyond filename.

independence_checks.csv.name: duplicate_check_method
independence_checks.csv.description: Byte hashes plus fruit/source lineage review; spectral similarity if registered.

independence_checks.csv.name: duplicate_check_result
independence_checks.csv.description: Retain exact findings, including ambiguous transformed duplicates.

harvest_observations_optional.csv.name: fruit_id
harvest_observations_optional.csv.description: Physical fruit identifier; do not pretend matched fruit are identical.

harvest_observations_optional.csv.name: paired_or_sentinel_fruit_id
harvest_observations_optional.csv.description: Matched/sentinel fruit if destructive assay uses another fruit; empty if inapplicable.

harvest_observations_optional.csv.name: criterion_id
harvest_observations_optional.csv.description: Independently sourced and frozen cultivar/market maturity criterion.

harvest_observations_optional.csv.name: decision_rule_id
harvest_observations_optional.csv.description: Frozen model-to-harvest decision rule, if evaluated.

harvest_observations_optional.csv.name: observation_type
harvest_observations_optional.csv.description: Registered variable: actual harvest, maturity assessment, or postharvest outcome.

harvest_observations_optional.csv.name: observation_value
harvest_observations_optional.csv.description: Value using the registered outcome definition.

harvest_observations_optional.csv.name: assessor_blinded_to_model
harvest_observations_optional.csv.description: true or false; retain actual blinding state.

harvest_observations_optional.csv.name: followup_protocol_id
harvest_observations_optional.csv.description: Frozen postharvest handling/assessment protocol if relevant.
